content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms fail because they control the infrastructure. Stripe rejects you. PayPal freezes accounts. Gumroad takes 10%. This stack removes intermediaries. You host on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. Orders store in Supabase or Google Sheets. Files deliver via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payments process through NOWPayments. You own every component. No platform can shut you down. No fees beyond 0.5% for payment processing. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more than Gumroad. This is not a workaround. It is base-layer infrastructure built for digital creators in regions where conventional platforms are unavailable or hostile.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: a domain name, a NOWPayments account, and your digital products. Buy a domain from Namecheap or Porkbun. Sign up for NOWPayments — no KYC required. Upload your ebooks, templates, or plugins to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Choose your preferred blockchain network for payments. BSC, Solana, and TRON cost under $0.10 per transaction. Decide which stack to deploy. Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all blueprints and templates. You do not need technical expertise. Follow the step-by-step guides. Deploy in 48 hours.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payment processing. Log in to NOWPayments. Create an API key. Set your pricing in USD. NOWPayments converts to crypto at transaction time. Test the payment webhook. It fires the moment payment confirms on-chain. Next, configure file delivery. If using Google Drive, generate shareable links for each product. If using Cloudflare R2, set public access. Write backend logic to verify payment and deliver files. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle this. Test the flow. Pay with test crypto. Ensure the correct file delivers. Your pipeline is now live. No platform touches your money or data.
Platforms take 10%. NOWPayments takes 0.5%. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store. If using GitHub Pages, push your code to the main branch. If using Cloudflare Pages, connect your repo. Configure DNS settings. Point your domain to the live site. Test the full flow. Buy a product using real crypto. Verify payment confirms on-chain. Ensure the file delivers instantly. Share your store link. Promote to your audience. Your first transaction proves the infrastructure works. No platform fees. No intermediaries. You control every step. The customer pays in crypto. The webhook fires. The product delivers. You own the data. You own the relationship.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Your stack is live. Now scale. Add more products. Optimize for mobile. Configure email delivery for receipts. Set up SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email security. Monitor transaction volume. Upgrade to Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for Supabase and end-to-end testing. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes scaling playbooks. Double your product catalog. Expand to new markets. Your infrastructure handles the load. No platform limits. No fees beyond 0.5%. You retain more revenue. You own more data. You build a sovereign business. This is not a temporary solution. It is permanent infrastructure. Built for creators who chose better architecture.

Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) include step-by-step guides. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates. No coding required. Deploy in 48 hours.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees: BSC, Solana, TRON. Transactions cost under $0.10. No buyer accounts required. Automatic webhook fires on payment confirmation.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?

No. This is not a subscription. You own the infrastructure after deployment. No platform fees. No hidden costs. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, you retain $921 more than Gumroad.
Can I sell multiple product types?

Yes. The stack supports ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Add as many products as needed. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes templates for every product type.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?

Your stack does not depend on NOWPayments for hosting or delivery. Payments process through their API. If they go down, switch to another crypto payment processor. Your store remains live. Your files remain deliverable.
